data.gender_notes: Athishta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Athishta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Athishta' which means 'Non-decaying' or 'Everlasting'. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring longevity, prosperity, and success to the bearer. The name Athishta carries the meaning “Non-decaying, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Athishta usually hope their child will grow to embody non-decaying, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the eternal and unchanging nature of the soul.
data.etymology: Athishta belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Non-decaying, Everlasting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Athishta total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Athishta is considered to represent the unchanging nature of the soul. historical_references.reference: Athishta was an ancient Hindu sage and one of the seven great sages (Sapta Rishis) of the Rigvedic period. He is believed to have been the author of the Atharva Veda, the last and most mystical of the four Vedas.

historical_references.reference: Athishta is also identified as Agastya, a revered sage in Hinduism, particularly in the southern part of India.
